neighbours.label: Token just before a predicted 'short/shorten/shortened' (duration-reducing verb or adjective): e.g. 'may' in 'may shorten the duration of colds', 'hospital stay is shortened', 'Keep baths short'. Fires on the word preceding the 'short' word, not on it.
fire: Recent trials suggest that zinc lozenges may shorten the duration of a common cold when taken early.
With better planning, the new surgical method is shown to cut recovery and hospital stay, which is shortened by several days.
To protect dry skin, keep baths short and use warm water rather than hot.
Researchers report that vitamin C supplements may shorten the length of symptoms in children.
The new highway should considerably shorten your commute, cutting the travel time to the city.
A faster compiler can greatly shorten the build time for large projects.
Taking an early flight will shorten the whole trip, so our layover is shortened too.
Regular exercise may shorten the time it takes to recover from the flu.
quiet: Pharmacies across the country now sell zinc lozenges in several flavors, mostly near the checkout counter.
Patients praised the surgical method for improving comfort and satisfaction after the operation.
For sensitive skin, nighttime baths with a gentle, fragrance-free soap work nicely.
In a petri dish, vitamin C supplements may extend the lifespan of certain cells.
Commuters worry the busy highway will lengthen their journey, adding extra time to every trip.
Our older compiler tends to increase build time for large projects.
A late flight will prolong the whole trip, and our layover is lengthy too.
Good sleep and daily walks may improve mood and overall energy.

notes: Label and sentences written blind by a Claude subagent from the card text alone (prompt: haiku_labeler/prompt.md, identical for Haiku, Sonnet and Opus); one retry on mechanical checks. Part of a Haiku/Sonnet/Opus comparison on the same 48 poles.
